short_description: Veridian Mobile's postpaid churn jumped from 0.94% to 1.73% a month — three drivers (a 5G core migration, a promo roll-off, a competitor's $25/line offer) answered with one blanket discount. A Retention Desk app ranks every account with a UC-registered XGBoost churn model + SHAP drivers, reads care calls with AI Functions, and a next-best-offer agent picks the driver-matched offer inside a hard margin guardrail, drafts the outreach and writes accept/decline back to Lakebase + Delta. CMO dashboard + Genie on the same tables.
